At desktop width a caption bar under the picture highlights the spoken word in guide-en-desktop, guide-es-desktop and guide-zh-Hans-desktop, and a Captions/Subtitulos/字幕 checkbox is visible. Fact toc ok: all 7 chapters are listed, each one landed on its expected start and became the active chapter, and every chapter is visible at 1280x800 in all three languages. The desktop screenshots show the full numbered list with durations in each language. At phone width a 'Chapter 1 of 7' selector with previous and next buttons sits right under the player (guide-en-phone, guide-es-phone, guide-zh-Hans-phone), so the list is one tap away.

Fact languages ok: es and zh-Hans each switch the title, the audio file (audio/v2/es, audio/v2/zh-Hans) and the first sentence to the expected text. guide-es-desktop and guide-es-phone are in Spanish throughout: controls, chapter list, call-for-help panel, picture label 'Revise si hay cinta', transcript and captions. guide-zh-Hans-desktop and guide-zh-Hans-phone are in Chinese throughout, with the picture label 检查有没有胶布. That is a small cosmetic issue, not a language failure.
